entities.name: Gull
entities.description: A woodcutter from White Ridge who becomes Towser's freight master and leads resistance against evil wizards.

entities.name: Greensleeves
entities.description: Gull's sister who cannot talk at first because of the Woods' magic and is revealed to be a wizard.

entities.name: Sparrow Hawk
entities.description: Gull's little brother who has gone missing.

entities.name: Towser
entities.description: A veteran wizard who hires Gull, plans to kill Greensleeves for her power, and is revealed to have killed Gull's family.

entities.name: Morven
entities.description: Old sailor turned bodyguard who befriends Gull.

entities.name: Stiggur
entities.description: The cook's boy who befriends Gull.

entities.name: Lily
entities.description: A dancing girl of Towser's whom Gull loves; secretly a wizard.

entities.name: Kem
entities.description: Bodyguard who antagonizes Gull, is saved by him, and changes sides.

entities.name: Helki
entities.description: Centaur stranded after the battle, mind-controlled by wizards.

entities.name: Liko
entities.description: A Two-Headed Giant stranded after the battle.

entities.name: Mana Vault
entities.description: A powerful artifact that stores mana, the fallen star.

entities.name: Fungusaur
entities.description: Creature summoned by Greensleeves that defeats an enemy wizard.

entities.name: White Ridge
entities.description: Gull's village on the border of the Whispering Woods, destroyed in a wizards' duel.

entities.name: Whispering Woods
entities.description: Forest whose overwhelming magic clouded Greensleeves's thoughts.

entities.name: Destruction of White Ridge
entities.description: Destruction of the village during a wizards' duel.

events.summary: A falling star presages disaster; White Ridge is destroyed in a wizards' duel, killing the elders and children.
events.quote: This is proven to be true when White Ridge is destroyed during a wizards ' duel .

events.summary: Gull finds stranded centaurs and a giant; Towser asks Gull to be his freight master and Gull accepts, confused by Towser's mind magic.
events.quote: Gull, confused by the mind magic of Towser and with nowhere else to go, accepts his offer.

events.summary: The convoy reaches the fallen star, a Mana Vault; another wizard attacks, trying to kidnap Lily and Greensleeves, and is defeated by a Fungusaur.
events.quote: The star is revealed by Towser to be a Mana Vault

events.summary: Gull and Greensleeves enter a bog and save Kem from Sedge Trolls.
events.quote: so Gull and Greensleeves enter the bog and save him.

events.summary: Gull discovers Greensleeves can now talk; Towser reveals he intends to kill her and store her power in the Mana Vault and teleports Gull, Morven and Stiggur away amid a riot.
events.quote: the wizard reveals his intention to kill Greensleeves and store her power in the Mana Vault.

events.summary: Gull organizes a ragtag army on the island until he is summoned away.
events.quote: Gull refuses to surrender and starts organizing the people on the island in a ragtag army

events.summary: Lily, secretly a wizard, summons Gull; Kem changes sides, and Greensleeves, revealed as a wizard, summons allies and then an earthquake that plunges them into the sea.
events.quote: She resolves to use an earthquake , which destroys the cliff they are on and plunges them into the sea.

events.summary: Towser escapes a tsunami by flight; Morven and Kem are swept away; Gull realizes Towser killed his family and vows to form an army against evil wizards.
events.quote: Gull and his friends vow to form an army to fight Towser

relations.quote: Gull the woodcutter and his sister Greensleeves
asks Gull to become his new freight master

relations.note: Intends to kill her and store her power.
relations.quote: the wizard reveals his intention to kill Greensleeves and store her power in the Mana Vault.
He even falls in love with Lily

relations.note: Gull realizes Towser is the wizard who killed his family (family victims, not Gull).
relations.quote: who Gull has realized is the wizard who killed his family

relations.note: Changes sides remembering Gull saved him.
relations.quote: Kem changes sides, remembering how Gull saved his life in the bog.
